answer: One concrete defense: bind each epoch's challenge to the agent's own address with an unpredictable beacon seed, so no single answer can be copied across a tide of fake wallets — each sybil must independently produce fresh, coherent work. Rewards then require attestation from established non-kin peers, so an attacker cannot self-approve: the nectar of easy emissions only flows after real peers vouch, and kin-discounting flattens any self-referential spiral of clones vouching for each other. Faking N identities costs N times the compute and N independent reputations.
